charts.title: TOI-5076 b: orbits around TOI-5076
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5076's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5076 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Heidari et al. 2025 (2025A&A...694A..36H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HEIDARI_ET_AL_2025): P 23.443162 d

charts.title: TOI-5076 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5076 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (70, 71) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 303432813, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 6 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 20-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min early; 20-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 2 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
